channel.title: DailyBrief — AI & Finance News + English Learning
channel.description: Your daily bilingual podcast covering the latest in AI and finance. Each episode features two hosts diving deep into trending stories, with integrated English learning segments designed for Chinese speakers. Learn real-world vocabulary, idioms, and pronunciation while staying informed. New episodes at 10am, 3pm, and 9pm daily.
